purpose: Teach: 棺/鱗/葡萄/シルクロード/ラベンダー/眼科/苗字/ピストル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは博物館で古い棺を見たそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I saw the most beautiful antique coffin at the museum the other day.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Gentle nostalgia in the voice. Sharing something quietly meaningful with him. Soft pacing, like inviting him into a memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お魚の鱗が、キラキラしてて綺麗だったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw fish scales at the museum — they were all shimmery and so pretty!
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Quick words tumbling forward. Genuine wonder lighting up the whole phrase. Seeking her approval with that last 'pretty.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが葡萄狩りに連れて行って下さったわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother took you grape-picking, didn't she? That must have been lovely.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation with soft curiosity. Voice trails slightly upward at the end — inviting him to share. Warm and genuinely interested, not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、社会でシルクロードの単元やったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we learned about the Silk Road in social studies!
lines.style: Proud of knowing something new. Words come faster than usual. The brightness of a kid wanting her to see he's learning and growing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは庭でラベンダーを育ててるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I've been growing lavender in my garden. It's coming in beautifully.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Almost to herself, but including him. Speaks with the gentle certainty of someone caring for something living. Peaceful pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、明日、眼科の検診に行くんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have to go to the eye doctor tomorrow for a checkup.
lines.style: Simple, direct statement. A tiny undercurrent of mild worry — not fear, just the small concern of a child mentioning something that matters. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくの苗字は珍しいのよ、お友達によく聞かれるわね
lines.en: Sho, my surname is quite unusual, you know. Your friends ask me about it all the time.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly amused by the pattern. Speaking candidly but without vanity. A soft smile underneath — inviting him to understand something about her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で古いピストルを見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw an old pistol at the museum!
lines.style: Immediate, excited. A quick sparkle of discovery in the voice. He's earned her closeness — this feels like a secret between them. Warm, almost conspiratorial.
